item.title: Short waits and clearer wrist buzz results
item.summary: Ask Murph to wait a few seconds before buzzing your WHOOP or Garmin, and to check whether the band accepted it.
item.details: Waits under a minute happen right away; longer delays still use reminders. If the Murph app is not open on your iPhone, Murph now says so instead of reporting a buzz that cannot arrive. Keep the app open with the band connected for delivery.

tryIt.label: Try a short wait
tryIt.prompt: Wait 5 seconds, then buzz my band once and tell me if it was accepted.
